_comment: Internal test-quality tool — NOT part of the published package and not
something adopters ever see (no docs page, no handbook section, no emitted
config). It answers one question about THIS repo's own suite: 100% line
coverage says every line ran, not that a wrong line would be caught.
StringLiteral is excluded on evidence, not taste: cutting the cause /
next-step half out of a self-explaining message already turns the suite
red, because field case law is fossilized sentence-by-sentence into
assertions. Mutating the ~4.5k remaining string literals would buy a
report of all-killed for a large chunk of the runtime.
